# Vincent Mugondora — vincentmugondora.com

> For full article content and detailed citations, see: https://vincentmugondora.com/llms-full.txt

## About
Vincent Mugondora is a Zimbabwean software developer, AI builder, educator, and entrepreneur based in Harare, Zimbabwe. He builds practical technology, teaches programming, and explores how software and AI can solve meaningful problems in Zimbabwe and across Africa.

## What Vincent Does
- Software development (full-stack, APIs, system architecture)
- AI solutions (AI agents, RAG systems, chatbots, automation)
- Web development (performance-optimized for African internet conditions)
- Technology education (teaching programming, AI, and software engineering)
- Speaking (AI, software engineering, technology in Africa, entrepreneurship)
